text:
Tess H.: Quick double announce: promoted to Senior PM (starting Mon) AND we’re expecting a baby in Sept! 🎉 Small potluck Friday 12:30 in the kitchen if anyone wants to drop by. No pressure.
Omar: Huge congrats!! :tada: I can bring sandwiches and a folding table.
Sophia: This is amazing news, congrats!!! 🥳
Grace: So happy for you. I can coordinate with People Ops on the promo blurb and bring GF brownies.
Liam: Congrats! Cake? I'll bring one. When should we post the announcement?
Julie: Cupcakes & a vegan option from me. Also happy to help hang a banner.
DeployBot: Heads up: office fridge cleanout scheduled Sun 8pm 'label or lose it' :fridge:
Tess H.: People Ops already has the promo copy. Promo live Mon. Thanks everyone, I'll send the invite. Registry link later, zero pressure.
Omar: I'll grab a small banner and some confetti. Balloons?
Sophia: Neutral + gold balloons sound nice. Playlist recs: "Good as Hell", "Lovely Day".
Grace: I'll do dietary labels for the spread.
Liam: Adding tentatively to the calendar. I'll DJ: mellow -> upbeat. Drop recs.
Julie: Song recs: "Walking on Sunshine", "Celebrate". Also bringing disposable cutlery.
Tess H.: You all are so sweet. Can't wait to see you Friday! :smiling_face_with_3_hearts:
